authority.repository: User explicitly authorized repeated direct-main commits. Each GitHub ref update uses the verified expected parent SHA and force=false; no PR, force push, workflow or protection change.
authority.runtime: The actual ObjectStore child reaches every native request. AdapterNet, AdapterAuth, ObjectStage and ObjectPublish remain scoped to the exact route resource; source/credential/journal access uses a separate metered live owner.
authority.network: No live device, real provider account or remote archive was contacted. Loopback scenarios were authored but not executed. Public-address plaintext, DNS, redirects and ambient credentials are not admitted.
authority.filesystem: Linux x86-64/AArch64 bounded regular source/credential reads and existing exclusive journal custody. Credential values are supplied by an owner-private file, never argv or reports.

delivered.scope: Exact PlannedChunk callback; bounds and source/payload/cleanup allowance before reads; durable source spend before callbacks; post-read cancellation/time checks; typed failures retain owner and acknowledged parts.

delivered.feature: Native signed local S3 multipart transport
delivered.scope: Pinned approved local endpoint; existing HMAC/SHA256 and Asupersync HTTP codec; SigV4; independent part and composite checksums; opaque ETags; conditional completion; bounded clean abort; exact cold recovery; conservative unknown after ambiguous dispatch; authentication restriction retained by durable owned metadata.

Full-source SHA256 verification before effects, independently retained preparation pin, exact intent/original allowance checks on resume, remaining-budget restoration, separately scoped filesystem ownership, private credentials, bounded redacted report, process regressions and operator documentation.

contracts.payload: Exactly one object, at most 64 MiB. Part default 5 MiB; admitted part ceiling 64 MiB. The manifest_root on this path is the independently supplied complete source SHA256, not an invented archive-graph closure proof.
contracts.publication: Complete only after all planned parts are independently checksum-confirmed; If-None-Match:*; validate complete success XML and composite checksum. HTTP200 embedded errors remain failures.
contracts.recovery: Prepare returns its durable pin without provider contact or credential reads. Resume/abort require a separately retained minimum, exact route/source/operation/plan and original allowance. Only remaining transfer allowance is admitted; acknowledged parts are not repeated.
contracts.uncertainty: Ambiguous native create/part/complete/abort never implies absence or rollback. CLI records explicit local indeterminate closure and the pre-settlement journal head as follow-up. Cold reopening that owner reports uncertainty without new provider/credential access. Native positive reconciliation is not implemented.
contracts.local_failure: Ambiguous journal writes poison the owner and require cold reopening. Prepared/refused-but-known work remains explicitly pending in its durable journal, without a detached socket or task. Terminal local settlement is separately reported.
contracts.compatibility: Existing upload_chunks, protocol checkpoint formats and upload-inspect report remain. Additive native recovery accessors and durable-owner guards preserve the existing owned-vs-protocol recovery distinction. New report: fss.s3_upload_cli.v1; endpoint domain: fss.s3_local_endpoint.v1.
